Getting started
=======================

This section will walk you through the initial steps needed to set up your environment and get NeuroFlow running.
You'll find instructions on how to install Python and configure it for NeuroFlow,
as well as how to install and configure NeuroFlow itself.  Let's get started!

* **Python setup**: Learn how to install Python and set up your environment for development.
* **NeuroFlow setup**: Get NeuroFlow up and running by following these installation instructions.
